Thanks, Soojin — attaching our standard PO template for billing: VeraSpace_PO_Template.pdf. A few answers up front:
- Signing entity: VeraSpace, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789). Billing should go to VeraSpace, Inc. (same).
- Payment terms: we usually run Net 45 for pilot procurements; can do Net 30 with approval from finance.
- SLA: target is 99.9% uptime (monthly), and p95 latency target for API calls; would like to understand how Redwood measures p99 vs p95 for billing/alerts.
- DPA: we require a DPA and local EU data routing for certain projects, but for this pilot US-only data is fine; will confirm if EU routing is required for future phases.

Well review the MSA and Order Form and provide redlines back by early next week. Can you share a brief SOW for the pilot scope (deliverables + acceptance criteria)?

Thanks — Jamie

Jamie / Soojin — thanks for the details and the PO template. A few initial legal notes (high level) so the commercial team knows what to expect:

1) Signing & billing entity: once we have the exact legal name well populate signature blocks. If VeraSpace will be using a parent entity or subsidiary, please confirm.

2) Payment terms & PO: Net 45 is acceptable for pilot; we typically accept PO-based billing but require the PO to reference the Redwood Order Form and include the signed MSA. Please confirm PO number placement.

3) SLA / credits: We do offer service credits; I will propose a bucketed credit schedule tied to monthly uptime %. We will need to align definitions (measurement window, scheduled maintenance windows, excluded outages).

4) Liability & indemnity: expect redlines on caps and carveouts — we will aim to keep commercial exposure aligned to fees but will ask for common carveouts.

5) Security / DPA: we already have a standard DPA. For EU routing ask, thats an ops/infra conversation; Marissa can coordinate the scoping. If VeraSpace needs encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys, flag that now.

Timeline: Ill circulate a redlined MSA + annotated Order Form by EOD 2026-08-06. If the team wants faster turnaround we can prioritize, but I want to set expectations.

Related: Ill generate a DocuSign envelope after signature-ready docs are agreed — placeholder: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c3d
